Container.Name: paperrust
Container.Overview:
PaperRust scans, recognises (OCR) and files your documents and makes them searchable. It is a fast, lean re-implementation of paperless-ngx 3.4.2 in Rust: same database, same files, same REST API and the same volume layout, so apps written for paperless-ngx keep working and you can switch over from an existing paperless-ngx container.
One container instead of five: web UI, worker, scheduler and consumption folder run in one process. No Redis, Celery, Tika or Gotenberg - only PostgreSQL 14 or newer is required (use the paperrust-postgres template or an existing PostgreSQL container).
Before the first start: set a long random Secret key, the database host and password, and an admin password. When switching from paperless-ngx, reuse its PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY and point PaperRust at the same database and folders - stop paperless-ngx first and take a backup.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: paperless paperless-ngx documents dms ocr scanner archive pdf
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL 14 or newer (for example the paperrust-postgres template from this repository).
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.2 - Mainly desktop-app changes; no database changes, update by pulling the new image. ### 0.1.1 - Multi-word search combines words with AND, as in paperless-ngx 3.4.2. Full release notes: https://github.com/paperrust/paperrust/releases

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Search index, classifier, logs and database backups taken before upgrades.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your documents (originals, archive PDFs, thumbnails). A share on the array is a good place for it.

Config.Name: Consume
Config.Description: Consumption folder: files dropped here (e.g. by a scanner) are imported automatically.

Config.Name: Export
Config.Description: Target folder of the document exporter (full backup).

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Required. Long random string, e.g. from 'openssl rand -base64 48'. When switching from paperless-ngx use the same value as before.

Config.Name: DB host
Config.Description: Required. IP address of your Unraid server (default bridge network) or the PostgreSQL container name (custom Docker network).

Config.Name: DB port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port.

Config.Name: DB name
Config.Description: Database name.

Config.Name: DB user
Config.Description: Database user.

Config.Name: DB password
Config.Description: Required. Same password as POSTGRES_PASSWORD of the PostgreSQL container.

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: First administrator, created on start if it does not exist yet.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the first administrator (only used when the user is created).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: OCR language
Config.Description: Tesseract languages used for OCR, e.g. deu+eng. Included in the image: eng deu fra ita spa.

Config.Name: Extra OCR languages
Config.Description: Additional Tesseract languages installed on start, separated by spaces (e.g. tur ces). Needs internet access.

Config.Name: Consumer polling
Config.Description: Check the consumption folder every N seconds (Unraid user shares do not report file changes reliably).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public address behind a reverse proxy, e.g. https://paperrust.example.com

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner UID of created files (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Owner GID of created files (Unraid: 100 = users).
